proposals.name: Customer
proposals.definition: A person who has a tax, National Insurance or childcare relationship with the agency.

evidence.quote: - **Customer**: A person who has a tax, National Insurance or childcare relationship with the agency. Synonyms: Taxpayer, Citizen, Person.

proposals.notes: Glossary lists Person as a synonym of Customer; TAXCORE keys every record on an internal Person Id (DA identifier) and other sources use 'person' for non-customers (e.g. a registered child). Whether Person is truly a synonym is an SME question.

proposals.name: National Insurance Number
proposals.definition: The lifelong reference that identifies a person for National Insurance.

evidence.quote: - **National Insurance Number**: The lifelong reference that identifies a person for National Insurance. Synonyms: NINO.

proposals.notes: Also an identifier (DA scope); issuer is contested between TAXCORE (2016 overview) and NumberHub (2023 NI procedures).

proposals.name: Employer
proposals.definition: An organisation that pays employees and files PAYE returns.

evidence.quote: - **Employer**: An organisation that pays employees and files PAYE returns.

proposals.notes: Employer Reference appears as the TC_EMPLOYER key in the data dictionary (DA identifier).

proposals.name: Employment
proposals.definition: A period during which a person is paid by an employer.

evidence.quote: - **Employment**: A period during which a person is paid by an employer.

proposals.name: Pay Period
proposals.definition: One period of pay, such as a week or month, reported in an employer return.

evidence.quote: - **Pay Period**: One period of pay, such as a week or month, reported in an employer return.

proposals.name: Tax Code

evidence.quote: - **Tax Code**: A code that tells the employer how much tax-free pay to allow for an employment.

proposals.name: NI Contribution
proposals.definition: An amount of National Insurance due for a pay period.

evidence.quote: - **NI Contribution**: An amount of National Insurance due for a pay period.

proposals.notes: Data dictionary splits it into employee and employer contribution amounts (DA attributes).

proposals.name: NI Record

proposals.name: Childcare Account

evidence.quote: - **Childcare Account**: An account a parent uses to pay a registered childcare provider.

proposals.definition: A registered nursery, childminder or club that is paid from a childcare account.

evidence.quote: - **Childcare Provider**: A registered nursery, childminder or club that is paid from a childcare account.

proposals.name: Child
proposals.definition: A child named on a childcare account.

evidence.quote: - **Child**: A child named on a childcare account.

proposals.name: Top-up Payment
